commits.message:
Add code quality and maintenance agentic workflows

Add four code quality workflows:
- code-simplifier: Daily simplification of recently modified code
- daily-file-diet: Identifies oversized files needing refactoring (>500 lines)
- repository-quality-improver: Rotating focus-area quality analysis
- markdown-linter-report: Super Linter-based markdown quality reporting
commits.attribution_evidence: no supported agent signature in commit metadata
